thread:
sam: Quick follow-up from yesterday's SSO postmortem. Starting a lightweight probabilistic pager-prune project to cut repeat pages without losing signal. Goal: reduce nightly noise by ~60% and keep alert fidelity for new failures.

miguel: Sounds good. I can do the initial noisy-alert inventory and attach counts. Will pull last 30d.

sam: Thanks. Draft action list below (owners + rough ETA):
1) noisy-alert inventory (miguel) - 3d
2) sketch probabilistic dedupe algorithm + sim (sam) - 1w
3) threshold smoothing + quiet-hours RFC (tanya) - 5d
4) canary rollout plan + monitoring hooks (lee) - 2w
I'll create cards on the remediation board.

miguel: Quick paste of top noisy alert keys from last 30d:
```
kvcache-miss-rate (infra) - 820 pages
token-service-4xx-burst (app) - 410 pages
auth-db-timeout - 295 pages
cert-renewal-failure (infra) - 190 pages
queue-depth-spike (ingest) - 170 pages
model-oom-events (runtime) - 120 pages
metric-emit-lag (telemetry) - 100 pages
webhook-429-burst (external) - 85 pages
plugin-reload-fail (platform) - 60 pages
redis-slowlog-avg - 45 pages
```
I'll upload CSV and a small notebook to the board.

tanya: For thresholds, proposing percentile-based smoothing rather than hard counts. Example rule for kvcache:
```
alert if p95 > 120ms for 5m AND rate(p95, 15m) > 2x baseline
night_suppression: mute 23:00-06:00 unless p99 > 500ms
```
Rationale: reduces churn from short transient spikes but keeps tail visibility.

lee: For canary, recommend staged rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 48h with automated rollback if page regression >5 pages/hour or false-suppression counter increases. Also add tracing tags so we can correlate pages to dedupe decisions.

sam: Important: initial dedupe should only probabilistically suppress duplicates of identical fingerprints for a short window. Start with p=0.7, ttl=10m. We must ensure the first unique occurrence still pages. Also add a conservative bypass for infra-level SEVs.

tanya: Agree. Also want a dashboard metric: pages_per_1000_alerts and false_suppression_incidents (manual unmute flag). Will add a query and Grafana panel.

ops-bot: remediation-board: card created -> https://org.kanban/PRUNING-68 (owners: miguel,tanya,sam,lee)

miguel: Uploaded CSV + notebook to the card. Will start slicing by team and time-of-day tomorrow.

sam: Next sync: Friday 10:00am PST. Post blockers here before then. Thanks :thumbsup:

lee: ack. I'll draft the canary playbook and include rollback runbook and telemetry events.

tanya: I'll post threshold PR + RFC in #docs for broader review and mention infra and runtime owners.

sam: Closing this thread for scheduling; reopen if we need an interim deep-dive.
